coastal.title: B.C.’s historic Little Red House destroyed by fire
coastal.description: The Langley Heritage Society said in an online post Friday that it was "sad and unfortunate" the home, also known as the McIver House, was never preserved.

kamloops.title: Summerland’s Twisted Whiskers closing as owner says wildfire added to business struggles
kamloops.description: A Summerland thrift store will permanently close its doors in December, after two difficult years in business and a summer tourism season disrupted by the Bald Range wildfire

kamloops.title: B.C. regional district lifts last of its evacuation orders for Ainslie Creek wildfire
kamloops.description: The Thompson-Nicola Regional District in southern British Columbia has lifted the last of its evacuation orders related to the out-of-control Ainslie Creek wildfire. The regional district says an order has been downgraded to an evacuation alert for 58 addressed properties in the Coldwater and Patchett Road areas.

prince-george.title: Cole Hosack vanished from Dawson Creek, B.C., in 2023. Does this man know what happened to him?
prince-george.description: New evidence, including a potential confession, has been uncovered in an investigation by the CBC's the fifth estate into the suspicious disappearance of a man in northern British Columbia.

southeast.title: Change needed after 'multiple failures' led to grizzly deaths, Wildsafe B.C. co-ordinator says
southeast.description: The outgoing community co-ordinator of Wildsafe B.C. Nelson is calling for change, after she says "multiple failures ... on many levels" led to the killing of a grizzly sow and two of her three yearlings this month.

southeast.title: RCMP investigating trio of suspicious wildfires in Grand Forks, B.C.
southeast.description: Firefighters in Grand Forks, B.C., were called to three wildfires this weekend they say are suspicious.

all.title: The where, when and how of fuel treatment decisions
all.description: With a big landscape, a limited budget and a diverse set of community objectives, how do we decide where, when and how fuel treatments are best undertaken to reduce wildfire risks? all.title: Wildland firefighters warned not to take supplements for smoke or PFAS exposure
all.description: A drug marketed to wildland firefighters exposed to smoke or PFAS shows no evidence of being effective, leading the International Association of Firefighters and the Food and Drug Administration to warn against its use. The drug, called glutathione, is marketed to fire fighters to remove toxins, but the IAFF says there are no scientific studies […]

all.title: Studying combined fuel treatments gives us a better picture of effectiveness
all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome.
